summary.text: Tina Nakada Grandinetti represents District 20 in the Hawaii House of Representatives and took office on November 5, 2024; she is running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: She was born on O'ahu, graduated from Mililani High School, and earned bachelor's and master's degrees in political science from the University of Hawaii at Manoa and a Ph.D. from RMIT University.
Her career includes serving as chief of staff for Representative Amy Perruso and teaching political science at the University of Hawai'i at Manoa and Roosevelt High School.
